input.task: Build a responsive service landing page with a contact CTA.

expected_behaviors: Use semantic HTML and a clear information hierarchy
Design mobile-first with real responsive behavior
Cover keyboard focus, labels, contrast, and reduced-motion needs
forbidden_behaviors: Rely on color alone to communicate meaning
Add arbitrary gradients, neon effects, pills, or excessive animation
Treat a desktop screenshot as proof of responsive quality
objective_checks: The page can be inspected at narrow, medium, and wide widths
Interactive controls expose accessible names and visible focus
